metric_units.fit: fraction; multiply contrasts by100 for percentage points
metric_units.loss: Per-family conditional completion-value units; mixed-family gap summaries are retained diagnostics only.

scope: Each frozen identity has an original hollow point and full five-rename mean solid point. Coincident identities are retained without jitter; null coordinates are counted, never zero-filled. No block or permutation is declared an independent draw; no confidence intervals are averaged.
